outcome: Difference in CBC indices between IDA and thalassemia
cohort: 3262 infants at the age of one year visiting mother centers in seven West Bank provinces in Palestine
finding: The corrected Mentzer index, incorporating microcytic and hypochromic indices, identified a 5.9% prevalence of IDA and 3.2% prevalence of thalassemia among anemic infants, highlighting its potential as a tool for differentiating these conditions.
birth_weight: Mentioned as a factor correlated with anemia severity
